title: CLAUDE.md: no Claude session links in commits or PRs
body:
Owner decision: from now on, commits and PR descriptions don't include a Claude session link or a \`Claude-Session:\` trailer.

Kept: \`Co-Authored-By: Claude\` in commits and the \"Generated with Claude Code\" line in PRs.

Already-merged commits and PRs are left as they are; changing merged commit messages would need a force-push.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
